hook_angle: problem-first callout to a skin type (oily skin, wrong moisturizer)
headline_text: Oily skin people - your moisturizer might be the problem.
visual_layout: video thumbnail: doctor in lab coat at a desk speaking to camera, product box and jar at bottom right
color_palette: white, dark green, soft mint; clinical, calm, trustworthy
risk_notes: relies on a doctor endorsement on camera; video format, so tagged from the thumbnail only and the headline is taken from primary text (no on-image headline); product name on the box is not legible in the thumbnail, name taken from visual notes
why_it_works: A doctor's sceptical expression plus a 'you might be doing it wrong' line creates curiosity and positions the product as the expert-approved fix. The product sits quietly in frame so the advice feels editorial, not salesy.
